question: In August 2024, who among the following was awarded the M.S. Swaminathan Award for Environment Protection 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anant Darshan Shankar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anant Darshan Shankar** is a well-known scholar in the field of **environmental protection** and **sustainable development**.
 
• He has made significant contributions towards the **conservation of biodiversity** and **promotion of traditional knowledge systems**.
 
• Shankar has been instrumental in integrating **traditional ecological knowledge** with modern scientific approaches for sustainable development.
 
• His work emphasizes the **importance of community participation** in environmental conservation.
 
• Shankar has received various accolades for his efforts in **environmental protection**, highlighting his dedication and impact in the field.
 
• The **M.S. Swaminathan Award for Environment Protection** is given to individuals who have made outstanding contributions in the field of environmental conservation and sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sundar Lal Bahuguna**__

 __
 
• **Sundar Lal Bahuguna** was a noted Indian environmentalist and **Chipko movement leader**.
 
• He was known for his efforts to protect the **Himalayan forests** and for promoting sustainable development.
 
• Bahuguna was also a strong advocate for the preservation of **natural resources**.
 
 
 
• **Sunita Narain**__
 __
 
• **Sunita Narain** is an Indian environmentalist and political activist.
 
• She is the director general of the **Centre for Science and Environment** (CSE) in New Delhi.
 
• Her work focuses on issues such as **climate change, water management, and pollution control**.
 
 
 
• **Rajendra Singh**__
 
 
• **Rajendra Singh** is known as the **"Waterman of India"** for his work in water conservation and management.
 
• He has been awarded the **Stockholm Water Prize** for his efforts in rejuvenating rivers and promoting water conservation in India.
